title: north star: six product areas, core feature list and grading tables
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbabAdcWyApSTGBYJNY

Filing gate: child of epic #35205, filed by seat 1 on the maintainer's 「立一张专题卡，开始执行」 (2026-11-18 14:43Z). Source order: /mnt/project-files/pm-orders/objectstack/seat1/priorities-rollout-2026-11-18.md. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What changes

The north-star document (the product priorities text that `AGENTS.md` points to as the ordering source) gains the agreed structure from #35205:
- The six product areas and their labels, with the two extra areas (`area:fleet`, `area:cloud`). Security is a private-channel area.
- The core feature list, one table per area, from the plan document.
- The Bug grading table (severity × how often hit), including the new cell "broken × used daily by builders = p1".
- The security table (who can trigger × who gains what).
- The extra rules: a Feature never enters p1; a Task defaults to p3; a card blocking another repo's p1 takes its grade; p1 goes ahead of every area; a paused area no longer demotes; in-flight cards are not regraded.

Also:
- Delete "the order from top to bottom is the order".
- Regroup "Features on the road" by area.
- Rewrite Priority rules 2 and 3 as the two-step method (pick the area, then look up the grade).

## Done when

- One PR, Tier H if the file is governed. `pm:awaiting-merge` and a review request go out the moment it is ready. The maintainer merges.
- The text matches #35205 and the plan's tables word for word on every grade cell.
